description.from: Add Corpus methods that return the catalog path, extracted text path for a snapshot and item, and graph manifest path for an extractor and snapshot, with feature specs. Remove PAPYRUS_* environment variable names from grobid_runtime.py in favor of BIBLICUS_* names only.
description.to:
## Goal
Biblicus owns its on-disk layout and exposes it. Remove the caller-specific environment names.

## Why
Papyrus computes Biblicus paths itself: `metadata/catalog.json`, `extracted/pipeline/<snapshot>/text/<item>.txt` (Papyrus `source_readiness.py`) and `graph/<extractor>/<snapshot>/manifest.json` (Papyrus `analysis_commands.py`). Biblicus `grobid_runtime.py` reads `PAPYRUS_GROBID_URL`, `PAPYRUS_GROBID_CONTAINER_NAME`, `PAPYRUS_GROBID_DOCKER_IMAGE`; a library must not know its caller's names.

## State when stopped
Branch `claude/project-thread-dmru5y-corpus-contract` is pushed with one `wip:` commit. It has new `features/corpus_layout_paths.feature` and `features/grobid_runtime_environment.feature` with step files, edits to `constants.py`, `corpus.py`, `extraction.py`, `graph/extraction.py`, docs (`corpus-design.md`, `feature-index.md`), and unexplained edits to `features/html_heuristics.feature` and its steps. None of it has been run.

## Work
1. Merge current `origin/main` into the branch.
2. Review the wip diff. Revert the `html_heuristics` edits unless they are required by this change and say why.
3. `Corpus` exposes `catalog_path()`, `extracted_text_path(snapshot_id, item_id)`, `graph_snapshot_manifest_path(extractor_id, snapshot_id)` returning `Path`, built from the same constants the writers use. If equivalents exist, document them instead of duplicating.
4. `grobid_runtime.py` reads only `BIBLICUS_GROBID_URL`, `BIBLICUS_GROBID_CONTAINER_NAME`, `BIBLICUS_GROBID_DOCKER_IMAGE`. No fallback to the old names. Update features, tests, docs. Also close Kanbus blbs-091ac0, including the duplicate `json_ld` layer if it is small.
5. Document the layout in `docs/corpus-design.md`.
6. Specs first, strict BDD, Sphinx docstrings, no line comments. Run the CI recipe. Coverage must not drop.

## Done when
PR to `main` is green. The PR body lists the Papyrus files that should switch to the new methods: `src/papyrus_content/source_readiness.py`, `analysis_commands.py`, `reference_curation_signals.py`.
